note: Every capture here is a public research dataset already used elsewhere in this portfolio. Paths point at the network-traffic-analysis repo rather than duplicating hundreds of megabytes of pcap. Nothing in this project is synthetic.

captures.why: LDAP reconnaissance against a domain controller. Gives directory-service traffic no other capture here has.
Kerberos service-ticket requests. Small, but it is the only Kerberos in the corpus.
EternalBlue exploitation over SMB. A short, dense burst against one target.
Torii botnet. Infected-device traffic with outbound command and control.
A benign Philips Hue device. This is the control group. Without benign traffic every detection scores perfectly and means nothing.

excluded.reason: Held out of the default build for runtime. scripts/build_full.sh adds it for the scale test, which is where the index numbers come from.
ICS traffic is a different problem shape from the auth and callback detections here. Held out to keep the corpus coherent rather than merely large.
